# NFL Daily — 2026-09-10 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- Seahawks opened the season with a win over the Patriots, but lost QB Sam Darnold to a hip injury; imaging ruled out a fracture and he's expected to miss Week 2. [NYT Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7580271/2026/09/09/patriots-seahawks-drake-maye-sam-darnold-score-results-takeaways/)
- Patriots WR A.J. Brown left the opener with what's believed to be a high-ankle sprain; X-rays were negative, MRI to determine severity. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49891924/sources-aj-brown-believed-high-ankle-sprain-set-mri)
- Falcons QB Tua Tagovailoa suffered an oblique injury at Thursday's practice ahead of Sunday's game vs. the Steelers; backup Cooper Rush took the first-team reps. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49895564/falcons-qb-tua-tagovailoa-suffers-oblique-injury-practice)
- Packers RB Josh Jacobs pleaded no contest to misdemeanor battery and property-damage charges; the NFL says he remains on the Commissioner's Exempt List with no timetable set for a discipline decision. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49893018/packers-rb-josh-jacobs-pleads-no-contest-misdemeanor-charges)
- Raiders TE Brock Bowers underwent meniscus surgery and is expected to miss 1-2 games to open the season. [FOX Sports](https://www.foxsports.com/stories/nfl/raiders-te-brock-bowers-undergoes-meniscus-surgery-expected-miss-1-2-games)
- 49ers TE George Kittle (Achilles) and DL Nick Bosa are off the injury report and will play in tonight's opener against the Rams in Australia. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/kittle-bosa-off-the-injury-report-will-play-in-week-1-vs-rams/)
- Chiefs QB Patrick Mahomes says he expects to play without limitations in Monday's opener vs. the Broncos, completing his return from a torn knee ligament. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49895082/chiefs-mahomes-expects-play-no-limitations-opener)

## Transactions
- _No qualifying transactions in this window._

## Injuries
- Falcons QB Tua Tagovailoa (oblique) was limited at Thursday's practice and is questionable; Cooper Rush took the first-team reps in his place. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49895564/falcons-qb-tua-tagovailoa-suffers-oblique-injury-practice)

# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-09-10 (Past 1 day)

## Key news
- A meeting between new DC Jesse Minter, OC Declan Doyle, and Lamar Jackson at Jackson's South Florida home set the tone for the staff's approach this season — described as a genuine partnership after years of skepticism from prior coaches. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7579957/2026/09/10/ravens-lamar-jackson-jesse-minter-declan-doyle/)
- WR Rashod Bateman addressed his offseason arrest publicly for the first time, saying "I can only say so much" ahead of Sunday's opener at the Colts. [The Baltimore Banner](https://www.thebanner.com/sports/ravens-nfl/ravens-rashod-bateman-arrest-colts-nfl-suspension-M64BZHG4VFAC5OZYUE2563OQ4E/)
